test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who has love for mankind

OR

One who makes an active effort to promote human welfare
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Philanthropist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Philanthropist"** refers to a person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by the generous donation of money to good causes. (परोपकारी)

 
 
• **Example:** The philanthropist donated millions of dollars to help build schools and hospitals in underdeveloped areas.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Philanthropist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Philosopher** (दार्शनिक): A person engaged or learned in philosophy, especially as an academic discipline.

 
 
• **Example:** Plato, a famous philosopher, wrote many works on ethics and politics.
 
 
 
• **Patriot** (देशभक्त): A person who vigorously supports their country and is prepared to defend it against enemies or detractors.
 
 
• **Example:** The patriot volunteered for military service to protect his homeland.
 
 
 
• **Autocrat** (सर्वसत्ता): A ruler who has absolute power.
 
 
• **Example:** The autocrat imposed strict laws without consulting his advisors.
 
 

32:T9e9,

The correct answer is: Option 2<
